novelty_flags.label: Proposition prop:causal-identification
novelty_flags.one_line: This is the standard correctly specified NPIV identification calibration, not a novel result.

novelty_flags.label: Conjecture conj:validated-misspecified-trae and comparator_promise_table
novelty_flags.one_line: The core calls the positive-defect branch a strict extension and marks Tan--Syrgkanis as a strict tightening, but no statement proves a formal strict comparison; the zero-defect theorem itself says it only recovers that benchmark.

soundness_flags.label: Definition def:misspecification
soundness_flags.one_line: Compactness of H_k guarantees existence but not uniqueness of the displayed argmin defining h_{H,k}^dagger; add convexity or an explicit deterministic tie-break.

soundness_flags.label: Open-ended Question oeq:sharp-witness-and-target-floor
soundness_flags.one_line: The displayed supremum does not state the ellipsoid constraint and uses epsilon_{H,k}, epsilon_{F,k}, and k without binding them to the diagonal experiment.

soundness_flags.label: Theorem thm:zero-defect-tan-syrgkanis-reduction
soundness_flags.one_line: The claimed optimized delta-rate does not follow uniformly from the truncated grid Lambda_n: no condition ensures that the grid reaches the oracle lambda scale for the declared delta_{k,n}.

soundness_flags.label: Assumption ass:mean-square-continuity
soundness_flags.one_line: This is Jensen contraction of the already defined conditional-expectation operator T, so it should be a derived lemma rather than a load-bearing assumption.

soundness_flags.label: Assumption ass:pseudotrue-attainment as used by the central conjecture and proposition
soundness_flags.one_line: Under ass:iv-validity and ass:completeness, h_0 attains zero residual and is the unique minimum-norm minimizer, so this additional attainment premise is unnecessary for those statements.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: conj:validated-misspecified-trae / honest_scope
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The headline remains conditional on existence of the attained minimum-norm pseudo-true projection in the sensitivity interpretation.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The proposed oracle inequality is a conditional point-estimation result for h^dagger; causal interpretation is restricted to the valid-IV and completeness branch.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Remark 3.8 says that relaxing the result to function approximation requires including misspecification error in the discrepancy noise; Theorem 3.13 gives squared strong error O(delta_n^(2 min{beta,1}/(1+min{beta,1}))) and weak error O(delta_n^2) for discrepancy-selected TRAE.
Theorem 12 includes target approximation and learned density/operator terms; Algorithm 2 and Theorem 13 use a separate validation sample and a regularized loss for RDIV model selection.
The paper defines a Tikhonov regularized adversarial population criterion and its empirical TRAE analogue under an exact inverse equation.
The proceedings version defines symmetric and star-convex witness classes and localized critical radii for minimax conditional-moment estimation.
The paper formulates NPIV as E[Y-h(X)|Z]=0, equivalently Th=r, and proves unique existence of the least-norm solution under existence of an inverse solution.

Add a grid-compatibility condition tying the smallest Lambda_n level to delta_{k,n}, or state the zero-defect rate as a continuous-lambda comparison rather than a consequence of the truncated grid.

Develop the diagonal lower-bound handle into a fully specified Assouad family with m_n, amplitudes, ellipsoid membership, KL bounds, and a formal mapping from excluded coordinates to epsilon_H and epsilon_F.
